info.title: Ichigo Aika: Strawberry Elegy
info.synopsis: Dopo le seconde nozze del padre, Kōta si ritrova a convivere con una nuova sorellastra, Aika. All'apparenza è una gyaru educata e rispettosa con i genitori, ma lontano dai loro occhi rivela un carattere vivace, impertinente e provocatorio. La convivenza all'inizio è difficile e il ragazzo fatica a tollerare i suoi atteggiamenti, che gli rendono la vita complicata. Con il passare del tempo, però, dietro la maschera ribelle emergono lati più autentici e affettuosi, e il rapporto tra i due prende una direzione inaspettata.

episodes.title: A Pair of Really Crappy Siblings!

tvdb.title: A Pair of Really Crappy Siblings!
tvdb.synopsis: Aika, the new younger sister of Kota Takamura from his father's remarriage, is a super sassy gal who bluntly calls her stepbrother “lame” upon first meet. Calling each other names, with each holding the worst impression of the other, they begin living under the same roof. But Aika would bring men into her room and get down to business whenever the parents were out. Kota is greatly troubled by her loud and clear moans, but then one day, something changes...

episodes.title: The Hell Are You?!

tvdb.title: The Hell Are You?!
tvdb.synopsis: That day, Aika was indulging in intimacy with her boyfriend Takahashi in her room as usual. However, a certain situation stirs trouble between them. To make matters worse for Aika, Kota, who had heard the commotion, shows up at the door. Aika tries to brush him off and send him away, but Kota makes a bold move that takes them both by surprise.

episodes.title: A Secret From Mom

tvdb.title: A Secret From Mom
tvdb.synopsis: Despite Aika skipping school and bringing boys home—behavior that could be called delinquent—she hides it from her parents and acts like a model daughter... Living together, Kota witnesses her dual nature firsthand. One day, Kota accidentally runs into Aika in the bathroom right after she's had a shower. Wondering which is the real Aika, he plucks up the courage to ask her directly...

episodes.title: A Ready-Made Duo

tvdb.title: A Ready-Made Duo
tvdb.synopsis: That night after the incident in the bathroom, Aika and Kota each lay in their own rooms, lost in thoughts of the other. Aika replays Kota's words and actions in her mind, sensing something different from the guys she'd dated before—guys who were only after her body. Late at night, Kota goes to the kitchen to prepare instant noodles for a late-night snack. Then, Aika comes over...

episodes.title: Aika's Close Call!

tvdb.title: Aika's Close Call!
tvdb.synopsis: Aika still lets Takahashi into her room, although today she seems unusually reluctant. The tactless Takahashi doesn't seem to care however, teasing that all guys get horny around the sexy Aika. Aika snaps and slaps him across the face. Takahashi then changes his tune, trying to force himself on her...

episodes.title: Just Hold Me Tight, Dammit

tvdb.title: Just Hold Me Tight, Dammit
tvdb.synopsis: Kota narrowly defeats Takahashi and succeeds in protecting Aika. But now, with Aika still in her disheveled state, she asks him to hold her tight, leaving him flustered. Out of a sense of responsibility as her older brother, Kota tells her to put her clothes back on properly. However, after she had tidied herself, Aika demands he embrace her once more. Kota found himself cornered, with nowhere to escape.

episodes.title: Breaking Down is a Bad Idea!

tvdb.title: Breaking Down is a Bad Idea!
tvdb.synopsis: From hugging to touching of the lips— Just when they were about to cross the line, Misaki comes home, leaving Aika and Kota unfinished. Just when that seemed to be the end of it, the next day, when their parents had gone out and they were alone together, Aika makes her move and asks if they can finish off from yesterday. Overwhelmed by Aika's bold approach, Kota almost goes with the flow again...

episodes.title: Why Don't You Take It Like A Man

tvdb.title: Why Don't You Take It Like A Man
tvdb.synopsis: The Takamura family heads to Atami for a trip! While his parents enjoy some couple time alone, Kota explores the sights by himself, making the most of the trip. Later, as he rests back at the inn, Aika returns to the room in her yukata after bathing. Kota can't help but be captivated by Aika's different, more traditional Japanese-style vibe—a change from her usual self. But Aika is quick to sense his gaze...

episodes.title: My Fave Kind of Guy!

tvdb.title: My Fave Kind of Guy!
tvdb.synopsis: The Takamura family's Atami trip continues! Aika and Kota arrive at the beach. While Aika, in her swimsuit, is strolling alone, she gets hit on by a guy. Though inwardly fed up, Aika decides to play it cool to avoid trouble. She tries to brush him off, casually dropping that her friend's here and makes her escape. But the unexpectedly clueless guy doesn't get the hint, and forcefully grabs Aika's hand, plunging her into an unexpected predicament.

episodes.title: Here Like Normal

tvdb.title: Here Like Normal
tvdb.synopsis: Now it's become perfectly normal for Aika to read manga in Kouta's room. She brings all the volumes out to read them all at once in the living room, but the moment she sees the dark hallway, she becomes strange and dejected, returning to Kouta's room. Aika confesses to Kouta that she's scared of being alone. Kouta assumes she just hates being on her own, but it seems there was more to it than that...

episodes.title: Kinda Bad-Boy, Don'tcha Think?

tvdb.title: Kinda Bad-Boy, Don'tcha Think?
tvdb.synopsis: Aika realizes she feels both excited and satisfied from her physical closeness with Kouta. Then at that moment, the image of a certain guy who once boasted that he'll teach her what real love is, flashes through her mind... Kouta, having finished his part-time job, was about to head home when he coincidentally runs into Aika, who was visiting as a customer. They end up going home together, but Aika leads him to a certain place.

episodes.title: From Teary To Twinkly

tvdb.title: From Teary To Twinkly
tvdb.synopsis: Aika boldly barges in on Kouta's bath time, holding a trendy bath bomb. Meanwhile, Kouta, concerned by Aika's tears he saw in the ruins, blurts out something that spoils the mood. However, Aika's reaction was different from what Kouta had expected. Sensing something, Kouta asks Aika to tell him about herself. Then, Aika begins to recount a certain event from her past.
